description: This repository's OWN Renovate config. Distinct from `renovate-config.json` beside it, which is the organization preset the other repositories extend — Renovate does not treat that file as a repository config, so without this one `.github` is not covered by its own policy.

It exists so the inheritance is explicit and visible in the repository, rather than depending on whether Renovate applies the organization default to a repository that has no config of its own. It also lets the Mend app run with `requireConfig=required`, which keeps repositories without a Renovate config — such as `demo-repository` — out of scope.

There are no local rules and there should not be: `.github` consumes GitHub Actions only, which `config:best-practices` already pins to digests and schedules monthly. Its permanent automerge exclusion lives in the org preset (see design D11), NOT here, because the reason is organizational — this repository has no branch protection and no CI, so an automerge would land with no gate at all — and keeping it there means it cannot be lifted by editing this file alone.
